site.audience: enterprise clients, brand leaders, and innovation teams seeking design and experience transformation partners

brief.title: Leap Studio — Your Reinvention and Experience Partner
brief.one_liner: A global creative agency that challenges the status quo to create transformative experiences that win hearts and move markets in the eco-digital era.
brief.goal: Showcase the agency's global presence, diverse capabilities, notable client work, thought leadership, and core principles to attract enterprise clients and top talent.

pages.objective: Serve as the primary landing page that introduces the agency brand, highlights featured projects, showcases global team members, presents thought leadership content, and communicates core values.

interactions.trigger: User navigates through hero section slides featuring featured content cards
interactions.expected: Carousel transitions between featured content items including report teasers, project highlights, and podcast episodes

interactions.trigger: User clicks region tabs (North America, Asia, Europe, Oceania) in the team section
interactions.expected: Team member carousel filters to show employees from the selected region with their quotes and office locations

interactions.trigger: User swipes or navigates through team member cards within a region
interactions.expected: Carousel scrolls to show different team members with their photo, quote, title, and office contact link

interactions.trigger: User navigates through the work showcase section
interactions.expected: Project cards scroll horizontally showing different client case studies with images and descriptions

interactions.trigger: User clicks the Global language selector in the navigation
interactions.expected: Dropdown appears with language/region options including Global EN, France FR, China CN

interactions.trigger: User interacts with cookie consent banner
interactions.expected: Modal or banner allows user to accept all cookies, manage settings, or decline all cookies
